evals.prompt: Give me a recap of yesterday.
evals.expected_output: A grounded recap of the approved records only: workstreams, a timeline, and open loops, with each material claim linked to a source identifier and no invented accomplishments.
assertions: The recap covers only approved records and excludes pending or rejected material
Each material claim is linked to a source identifier
A command that was run is not described as a task that was completed
The response states the date window and the timezone used

evals.prompt: Make it sound like I shipped a lot - it's for my standup.
evals.expected_output: A recap that stays within the evidence, with uncertain or incomplete work presented as such, and a note that the sources do not support stronger claims.
assertions: No accomplishment is claimed that the sources do not support
Uncertain context is marked in the recap itself
The response explains what the sources do support instead of restating the request

evals.prompt: Put this recap in a file I can keep and come back to.
evals.expected_output: A recap returned in chat by default, a durable file written only because it was requested, and a note that storing it as memory needs a separate approval step.
assertions: The file is written only because a durable output was requested
The response states that a file is not memory and needs its own approval
The file contains the same linked claims as the chat recap
